boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on nearby Elizabethtown corridors, each with a documented reason to visit.

cards.title: Elizabethtown Public Library
cards.subtitle: S. Market Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the library at 10 S. Market Street for its public library services; check its current program calendar before making a special trip.
cards.short_summary: A public-library stop on the Market Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Lancaster Libraries lists Elizabethtown Public Library at 10 S. Market Street.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current opening hours and any event requirements with the library.

cards.title: Hub on Market
cards.subtitle: S. Market Street corridor
cards.notes: Stop at 206 S. Market Street to browse the Hub’s listed boutiques and artisans, or consult its site for its coffee and coworking tenants.
cards.short_summary: A mixed-use marketplace and workplace on Market Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Hub on Market identifies itself at 206 S. Market Street and describes more than 50 boutiques and artisans.
cards.access_notes: Individual retailers and services may have separate availability and purchase requirements.

cards.title: Elizabethtown Amtrak Station
cards.subtitle: S. Wilson Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the station as a rail departure point after checking Amtrak’s current schedule, fares, accessibility details, and platform instructions.
cards.short_summary: A Keystone Service and Pennsylvanian rail stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Great American Stations states that Elizabethtown is served by Amtrak’s Keystone Service and Pennsylvanian.
cards.access_notes: Train travel requires a valid ticket; verify current service directly with Amtrak.

cards.title: Elizabethtown Borough Community Park
cards.subtitle: S. Hanover Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk the park’s paths or use its basketball courts, amphitheater, playground equipment, Veterans Memorial, and softball-field area.
cards.short_summary: A borough park with paths, courts, an amphitheater, and memorial.
cards.evidence_claim: The Borough describes Community Park as a 20.653-acre developed park with courts, playground equipment, an amphitheater, Veterans Memorial, and softball field.
cards.source_title: Parks and Recreation — Borough of Elizabethtown
cards.access_notes: Pavilions are rentable; consult the Borough for facility policies and reservations.

cards.title: Formal Gardens at Masonic Village
cards.subtitle: Masonic Drive corridor
cards.notes: Follow the public garden walks toward Grand Lodge Hall, pausing at the fountain and reflection pool along the way.
cards.short_summary: Six and a half acres of public gardens and walking trails.
cards.evidence_claim: Masonic Village says its Formal Gardens are open to the public and include walking trails, a fountain, and reflection pool.
cards.access_notes: Use the campus map and respect posted property guidance while visiting.

cards.title: Grand Lodge Hall
cards.subtitle: Masonic Drive corridor
cards.notes: Use the campus map to locate Grand Lodge Hall and its listed library, lifelong-learning center, creative-arts studio, and restaurants.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus focal point with several listed amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: Masonic Village identifies Grand Lodge Hall as a historic focal point housing a library, lifelong-learning center, creative-arts and ceramics studio, and restaurants.
cards.access_notes: Amenities have separate access arrangements; verify availability before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Masonic Village Farm Market and Orchard View Café
cards.title: Masonic Village Farm Market and Orchard View Café
cards.subtitle: Masonic Drive corridor
cards.notes: Visit the Farm Market for produce and local goods, or check the Orchard View Café’s current service before planning a food stop.
cards.short_summary: A farm-market and café destination on the Masonic Drive campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Masonic Village states that its Farm Market stocks produce and other local goods and that Orchard View Café serves ice cream and specialty sandwiches.
cards.access_notes: Products and café food are purchased separately; confirm current service before going.

cards.title: Sell Chapel
cards.subtitle: Masonic Drive corridor
cards.notes: Check the chapel’s current schedule if you would like to attend a service offered to both residents and the wider community.
cards.short_summary: A non-denominational chapel serving residents and the greater community.
cards.evidence_claim: Masonic Village describes Sell Chapel as an active non-denominational congregation offering services to residents and the greater community.
cards.access_notes: Verify service times and visitor arrangements directly with Masonic Village.

cards.title: Clinics Building
cards.subtitle: Masonic Drive corridor
cards.notes: Use the campus map to locate the Clinics Building and contact the appropriate provider directly for appointment and visitor information.
cards.short_summary: A mapped campus building for multiple health-care services.
cards.evidence_claim: Masonic Village lists dental, podiatry, eye care, audiology, orthopedic, behavioral-health, dermatology, and outpatient-rehabilitation services at its clinics.
cards.access_notes: Health-care services require provider-specific arrangements and may not be walk-in.

cards.title: Masonic Village Visitors Center
cards.subtitle: Masonic Drive corridor
cards.notes: Arrange a campus tour through the Visitors Center if you want orientation to the Masonic Village grounds and its mapped amenities.
cards.short_summary: The campus point for arranging a guided Masonic Village tour.
cards.evidence_claim: Masonic Village says its sales and marketing team offers tours and guidance for people interested in its campus.
cards.access_notes: Schedule a personal tour with Masonic Village’s sales and marketing team.
